sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Afghanistan entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's current Afghanistan country sheet is Italian passport-government guidance. It identifies a visa requirement but reports refusals despite visas and does not establish a usable ordinary-visitor issuance route.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Central African Republic entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's current Central African Republic country sheet says entry requires a visa and identifies the competent embassy in Paris for information, but does not establish an Italian ordinary visitor's actual issuance point or timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visto di ingresso necessario. Non esiste un’Ambasciata della Repubblica Centrafricana a Roma.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: South Sudan entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's current South Sudan country sheet is Italian passport-government guidance. It says an entry visa is required but does not directly establish an ordinary Italian-passport issuance channel.

sources.title: South Sudan eVisa: online visa workflow
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Interior eVisa service describes a pre-travel electronic workflow, but asks applicants whether they are eligible and publishes no direct ordinary Italian-passport eligibility rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours

unresolved.reason: MAECI directly states that a visa is obligatory, but reports refusals despite visas amid recognition and operational constraints. It establishes no usable ordinary Italian visitor issuance channel or timing.

MAECI says an entry visa is necessary and identifies the competent CAR embassy in Paris for information, but does not establish whether an ordinary Italian visitor is issued a visa before travel, electronically, or at the border.

MAECI says an entry visa is necessary. South Sudan's official portal proves electronic delivery can occur before travel, but does not directly establish ordinary Italian-passport eligibility; no nationality-specific issuance route is inferred.
